author: AtditC
body:
User which broke rules: raziki9
Victims: 'enemy team'
Evidence: 'bottom of page'
Date recorded live: 08.30.2015
Date evidence was edited: 09.03.2015
Date evidence was uploaded: 09.03.2015
(mm.dd.yyyy)
If you need any more informations like "What is the exact time?" etc., just ask and I'll answer.

Evidence : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_y-NH_Gj2tk
    backup: http://www.atdit.ch/Videos/CSOutPut/raziki9-antikb/index.html

Description: He was suspisous because he broke all monuments so fast, I'm sure if someone might be hacking or not, so I tp'ed to him and spectated him. herobrine2wins, which was also spectating him, might have been his accomplice, which looked for any moderators to join the game, and look at him. He (herobrine2wins) said after I asked him "did you also think that he was hacking?" rude things to me like "stfu" etc. A report for him has already been made 4 days ago. Anyways. raziki9 was using suspected fly hacks, anti kb modifications and maybe kill aura.

Greetings,
Atdit.
